# Kspec Automation Session - Task Work

**Session ID:** `01KJKCGRAVN1BTZ611MX7EK5H3`
**Iteration:** 1 of 30
**Mode:** Automated (no human in the loop)


### Current State

> **Truncated** (104281 bytes). Fetch full data:
> ```
> kspec session start --json
> ```
>
> Summary: `{}`

## Instructions

Run the task-work skill in loop mode:

```
$kspec-task-work loop
```

Loop mode means: no confirmations, auto-resolve decisions, automation-eligible tasks only.

**Normal flow:** Work on a task, create a PR, then stop responding. Ralph continues automatically —
it checks for remaining eligible tasks at the start of each iteration and exits the loop itself when none remain.

**Do NOT call `end-loop` after completing a task.** Simply stop responding.
`end-loop` is a rare escape hatch for when work is stalling across multiple iterations with no progress — not a normal exit path.

```sh
OK Started task: 01KJK9DV

--- Spec Context ---
Implementing: Ralph Subagent Spawning

Ralph can spawn ACP subagents for dedicated tasks (e.g., PR review). Subagents are separate Claude Code processes with focused prompts. Subagents run sequentially (ralph waits for completion).

Acceptance Criteria (13):
  [ac-1]
    Given: ralph needs subagent
    When: spawn initiated
    Then: new ACP process started with dedicated prompt
  [ac-2]
    Given: subagent spawned
    When: prompt provided
    Then: prompt includes task ref, skill to invoke (/pr-review @task), context, and explicit review-only role boundary (never fix code)
  [ac-3]
    Given: subagent running
    When: ralph behavior
    Then: ralph waits for subagent completion before continuing
  [ac-4]
    Given: subagent runs
    When: display
    Then: subagent output rendered same as main agent (single stream)
  [ac-5]
    Given: subagent completes
    When: signaling
    Then: task status change (completed/needs_review) indicates outcome
  [ac-6]
    Given: multiple pending_review tasks
    When: spawning
    Then: processes one at a time sequentially
  [ac-7]
    Given: subagent runs
    When: resource management
    Then: respects ralph's --max-retries and failure limits
  [ac-8]
    Given: ralph iteration begins
    When: ralph checks task statuses
    Then: pending_review tasks detected trigger subagent spawn by ralph (host) before main agent iteration continues
  [ac-9]
    Given: subagent is running
    When: subagent exceeds timeout (default 10 minutes)
    Then: ralph terminates subagent and marks task automation: needs_review with timeout note
  [ac-10]
    Given: subagent prompt is built
    When: context is assembled
    Then: includes compact identity summaries of task details and linked spec (with CLI fetch commands for full data), and current git branch
  [ac-11]
    Given: subagent output is displayed
    When: rendering to terminal
    Then: output includes [REVIEW SUBAGENT] prefix to distinguish from main agent
  [ac-12]
    Given: subagent successfully merges PR
    When: workflow completes
    Then: subagent must complete the task (kspec task complete) before exiting; ralph verifies task is completed after subagent success
  [ac-13]
    Given: subagent completes review with blocking findings
    When: subagent exits
    Then: task transitions to needs_work; worker picks it up in next iteration as fix cycle

Remember: Add test coverage for each AC and mark tests with // AC: @spec-ref ac-N
```
